authority: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)

canonical_corpus.citation_title: Prohibition of Assured Returns (SEBI Circular CIR/2023/123)
canonical_corpus.full_title: SEBI Investor Caution: Advisory Against Schemes Offering Guaranteed/Assured Returns
canonical_corpus.governing_act: SEBI (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013 and SEBI (Research Analysts) Regulations, 2014
key_clauses: Prohibition of offering or promising assured, fixed, or guaranteed returns on securities investments.
Prohibition of zero-risk, capital protection, or sure-shot profit claims on social media or messaging platforms.
Mandatory disclosure that securities investments are subject to market risks.

canonical_corpus.citation_title: Unregistered Intermediaries & Closed Group Solicitation (SEBI Circular CIR/2024/45)
canonical_corpus.full_title: SEBI Master Circular on Unregistered Online Investment Platforms and Virtual Trading Apps
canonical_corpus.governing_act: SEBI Act, 1992 Section 12(1) and SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008
key_clauses: Prohibition of unregistered entities soliciting investments through closed channels including Telegram, WhatsApp, and private groups.
Prohibition of claiming institutional FII/FPI quota access for retail investors through dedicated mobile applications.
Requirement that every intermediary display valid registration numbers starting with INA, INH, or INZ verified on sebi.gov.in.

canonical_corpus.citation_title: RBI Cautionary Alert List on Unauthorized Forex & Trading Apps
canonical_corpus.full_title: Reserve Bank of India Advisory on Unauthorized Online Forex and Investment Trading Platforms
canonical_corpus.governing_act: Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999 (FEMA) and PMLA, 2002
key_clauses: Unauthorized offshore digital trading apps are illegal for Indian residents.
Collection of funds through personal domestic UPI IDs for foreign speculative schemes violates FEMA rules.

canonical_corpus.citation_title: NSE Public Alert on Social Media Stock Tipsters and Pump-and-Dump Schemes
canonical_corpus.full_title: National Stock Exchange Public Notice: Advisory on Unsolicited Stock Recommendations
canonical_corpus.governing_act: SEBI (Prohibition of Fraudulent and Unfair Trade Practices) Regulations, 2003 (PFUTP)
key_clauses: Caution against trading penny stocks based on speculative messages in Telegram/WhatsApp groups.
Only SEBI-registered Research Analysts (INH) and Investment Advisers (INA) may publish recommendations with research reports.
